title: Footer identity
summary: Fills slot.footer.identity with operator-owned shop name, tagline and copyright. Kernel and theme only provide the slot.

blocks.title: Slot only
blocks.text: front/index.tsx sets slots[CORE_FRONT_SLOTS.footerIdentity] to <FooterIdentity />. PluginSlot in the kernel footer renders it. Edit copy on Plugins → Configure. Defaults are Shop, empty tagline, empty also-known-as, empty copyright suffix, plus the current year.

blocks.caption: front/index.tsx

blocks.text: Default path: same folder as package.json (config.json, gitignored config.private.json, committed config.private.example.json). Optional tuucho.configDir. Merge matches kernel JSON (common then env, private or example). Boot does not overwrite Admin values. First launch loads files once when settings are still empty. Edit in Admin → Plugins → Configure, or Update from files / Import / Export there.

items.description: string — public. Name shown in the footer identity slot. This is operator-owned copy, not kernel JSON.
text — public. Short line under the shop name. Leave empty to hide it.
string — public. Optional extra trading name. Leave empty if the shop has only one name.
string — public. Text after the year in the footer copyright line.
